title: Shared Local Memory (SLM) Bank Conflict Padding
prompt: Implement a Python function `calculate_padded_slm_stride(tile_width: int, bank_count: int = 16) -> int` that calculates the row stride in elements for allocating 2D tile arrays in Intel Xe Shared Local Memory (SLM). If tile_width shares a common factor with bank_count (i.e. gcd > 1), add minimal 1-element padding to guarantee gcd(stride, bank_count) == 1 and avoid bank conflict serialization.
target_invariant: Returns tile_width + 1 if gcd(tile_width, bank_count) > 1 else tile_width.
